opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers toward registering and funding an MTI account while portraying participation as a path to financial freedom. It presents MTI as an opportunity that “anyone anywhere can benefit from with patience and trust,” and tells viewers they can win as members. It reinforces that appeal with reported investment and withdrawal amounts, including an initial $2,200 investment and three withdrawals exceeding $9,000, then associates a $100 investment with “40,000% potential growth on a $100 investment without doing anything.” Those reported results and projections are unverified. Although the speaker says “There are no guarantees, we don't control the market nor do we control the price of bitcoin,” that disclaimer does not remove the promotional force of the registration, funding, financial-freedom claims, and extraordinary projected growth.
